result.title: Can MLLMs Reason over Surround-View Driving Videos? A Multi-View Autonomous Driving QA Benchmark
result.summary: Surround-view video understanding in autonomous driving is a crucial capability for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to achieve reliable driving reasoning. Real-world driving often requires information beyond the front-view camera. Existing MLLMs primarily focus on front-view information, while their spatio-temporal understanding and reasoning abilities remain unknown. To address this gap, we propose MVDriveBench, a high-information-density video QA benchmark for autonomous driving, characterized by synchronized surround-view inputs, spatio-temporal understanding, and reasoning-chain-oriented evaluation. We design 12 categories of QA tasks that cover the complete reasoning pipeline from low-level visual perception to high-level driving decision-making, enabling a systematic evaluation of MLLMs surround-view spatio-temporal understanding and reasoning capabilities in complex driving environments. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation of 23 open-source, closed-source, and expert MLLMs on MVDriveBench. The results show that current MLLMs still exhibit insufficient surround-view spatio-temporal reasoning ability. Meanwhile, closed-loop evaluations of specialist models in AlpaSim reveal a correlation between surround-view spatio-temporal reasoning capabilities and closed-loop driving performance, highlighting the importance of comprehensive multi-view understanding for reliable vehicle control.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MVDriveBench，一个同步环视视频 QA 基准，设计 12 类任务覆盖从低层视觉感知到高层驾驶决策的推理链，评测 23 个开源、闭源与专家 MLLM，并在 AlpaSim 闭环中检验多视角时空推理与驾驶表现的相关性。
AI.relevance_reason: 作为多视角时空推理的诊断型基准，可供核查 MLLM 是否在内部状态中保留跨视角视觉细节与实体关系证据、以及推理链评价如何与最终决策挂钩；但属驾驶场景专项评测，未涉及 latent 状态的生成与使用。
